name: The White Stripes

whyMatters.en: Detroit duo formed in 1997. White Blood Cells (2001) and Elephant (2003, Toe Rag / Liam Watson) kept guitar, drums, and vocal with no bass; Seven Nation Army’s Digitech Whammy octave riff became a global chant.
whyMatters.zh: 底特律双人组，1997 年成立。《White Blood Cells》（2001）与《Elephant》（2003，Toe Rag / Liam Watson）保持吉他、鼓、人声、无贝斯；《Seven Nation Army》的 Digitech Whammy 八度 riff 成为全球口号。

essentialTracks.title: Fell in Love with a Girl

lyricQuotes: I'm gonna fight 'em off / A seven nation army couldn't hold me back
Red blood / Can't be found on a white dress

shortBio.en: Jack / Meg White Detroit duo, 1997–2011. Seven Nation Army is the best-known riff; Elephant the mainstream album.
shortBio.zh: Jack / Meg White 底特律双人组，1997–2011。《Seven Nation Army》是最知名 riff；《Elephant》是进入主流的专辑。

body.en:
The White Stripes formed in Detroit in 1997. Sympathy for the Record Industry releases and White Blood Cells (2001) kept recording raw: no bass, Meg’s floor-tom-heavy drums, Jack’s blues bends and fuzz. The red-white-black visual rule stayed fixed.

Elephant (2003) reached a wider audience via Seven Nation Army’s octave-pedal riff and Toe Rag’s vintage compression. Icky Thump (2007) added bagpipes and a Nashville-recorded punch while keeping the two-piece lineup. The band ended in 2011.
body.zh:
The White Stripes 于 1997 年在底特律成立。Sympathy for the Record Industry 发行与《White Blood Cells》（2001）保持毛糙录音：无贝斯、Meg 的地鼓重击、Jack 的蓝调推弦与 fuzz。红白黑视觉规则固定。

《Elephant》（2003）借《Seven Nation Army》的八度效果器 riff 与 Toe Rag 复古压缩进入更广听众。《Icky Thump》（2007）加入风笛与纳什维尔录制的冲击感，仍为二人组。乐队于 2011 年结束。

scenes.track: Fell in Love with a Girl

note.en: From White Blood Cells; about 1:50, raw mix; Michel Gondry Lego video.
note.zh: 出自《White Blood Cells》；约 1:50、毛糙混音；Michel Gondry 乐高 MV。

note.en: From Elephant; Digitech Whammy octave line stands in for bass; widely used as a stadium chant.
note.zh: 出自《Elephant》；Digitech Whammy 八度线代替贝斯；广泛用作体育场口号。

note.en: Title track; bagpipes into blues stomp; Nashville sessions, late-period duo single.
note.zh: 同名曲；风笛接蓝调 stomp；纳什维尔录音，后期双人组单曲。

title.zh: 无贝斯的蓝调车库双人组

body.en:
The White Stripes limited the band to guitar, drums, and vocal. Blues bends, fuzz, and Meg’s straight drum patterns carried the songs.

In the early 2000s that reduction sat on rock and indie radio beside denser nu-metal and garage-revival peers. Seven Nation Army’s Whammy line is the clearest technical fact: one guitarist covering a bass-like part on a widely chanted riff.
body.zh:
The White Stripes 把编制限在吉他、鼓、人声。蓝调推弦、fuzz 与 Meg 的直鼓型支撑歌曲。

2000 年代初，这套减法与更密的 nu-metal、以及其他车库复兴同伴同处摇滚与 indie 电台。《Seven Nation Army》的 Whammy 线是最清楚的技术事实：一名吉他手在广为传唱的 riff 上覆盖贝斯式声部。

body.en:
Jack White handled riffs, leads, and piano overdubs. Meg White kept straight drum patterns and few flash fills.

There were no lineup substitutions in the usual band sense: the two-person limit ran from 1997 to 2011.
body.zh:
Jack White 负责 riff、主音与钢琴叠录。Meg White 保持直鼓型，少用炫技 fill。

常规意义上无替补阵容：双人限制贯穿 1997–2011。

title.zh: 车库复兴与体育场口号

body.en:
Alongside The Strokes, they were a main US garage-revival reference for raw guitar reduction. Seven Nation Army crossed into sports chants beyond indie press.

Later UK indie acts, including Arctic Monkeys, often cite the lo-fi duo records of this period.
body.zh:
与 The Strokes 并列，他们是美国车库复兴中毛糙吉他减法的主要参照。《Seven Nation Army》进入 indie 媒体之外的体育口号。

后来的英国 indie（含 Arctic Monkeys）常引用这一时期的 lo-fi 双人组唱片。

title.en: Fell in Love with a Girl

body.en: Short blast from White Blood Cells with a raw mix. The Michel Gondry Lego video widened the song’s reach on MTV and online clips.
body.zh: 出自《White Blood Cells》的短爆发曲，毛糙混音。Michel Gondry 乐高 MV 扩大了 MTV 与网络片段上的传播。

body.en: Digitech Whammy octave line mimics a bass part; Meg’s drums stay spare. From Elephant, it became the band’s most widely known riff.
body.zh: Digitech Whammy 八度线模拟贝斯声部；Meg 的鼓保持稀疏。出自《Elephant》，成为乐队最广为人知的 riff。

body.en: Bagpipes open into a blues stomp. Recorded in Nashville, it is a late-period single that still keeps the duo rule.
body.zh: 风笛开场接蓝调 stomp。在纳什维尔录制，是仍守双人规则的后期单曲。

interviewQuotes.text: Limitation is the point. Two colors, two people, no bass.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jack White

interviewQuotes.text: Meg’s drums are the swing. Overplaying would kill it.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jack White

note.en: No bass; red/white visual rule; garage and blues writing as two-piece.
note.zh: 无贝斯；红白视觉规则；以二人组写车库与蓝调。

note.en: Octave-pedal riff that became a stadium chant.
note.zh: 八度踏板 riff，后成为体育场口号。

note.en: Detroit garage revival with blues writing and a fixed duo lineup.
note.zh: 底特律车库复兴，蓝调写法，固定双人编制。
